perspective:
Ethan’s available information:

- He is Ethan Mohamud, a plumber. Gary Guo is his long-time friend from middle school and works as a doctor.
- He knows he and Gary have maintained a close friendship across different careers and have supported each other.
- He noticed Gary working excessively long hospital hours, skipping meals, and sacrificing sleep. He became concerned.
- He invited Gary to a weekend retreat for relaxation and rejuvenation.
- He told Gary that his health matters, that he hates seeing him like this, and suggested two days might give him a new perspective.
- He heard Gary decline, saying he appreciated the concern but had too much to do at the hospital.
- At the retreat, Ethan observed Gary acting restless and avoiding discussions about work. Ethan suspected there was more to Gary’s overworking than professional obligations.
- Ethan confronted Gary, saying they had been friends since middle school, that Gary could tell him anything, and that he was there to help, not judge.
- He heard Gary say it was complicated and that he did not want to burden Ethan with his problems.
- Gary then opened up to Ethan about the pressures of managing a new department and personal challenges he was facing.
- Ethan felt relief and empathy. He suggested prioritizing tasks and delegating responsibilities so Gary did not have to do everything himself.
- He heard Gary agree and say he could use help organizing his schedule to make time for himself.
- Over the following months, Ethan regularly checked in with Gary, discussed his progress and challenges, and saw Gary making efforts to change.
- Ethan felt hopeful and proud. He told Gary he was proud of his progress and was there whenever Gary needed to talk.
- He heard Gary say things were better, that Ethan’s help meant he was less overwhelmed, and that he had had time for a movie the previous weekend.
- After a year, Ethan saw Gary managing on his own and felt satisfied and happy for him.
- Ethan decided to step back but told Gary he was always just a call away, that he knew Gary had this, and to keep up the good work.
- He heard Gary thank him, say he could not have done it without Ethan’s support, and that he felt more in control now.
